title: Access and Scheduling Standards of Linden Memberships
content:
Linden Ridge Medical Group sets the access standards of each Linden Memberships tier as follows: whether a same-day visit is guaranteed and the hour of the day before which a same-day request must be made; the hours within which a member's MyLinden portal message gets a clinician reply; whether the member can reach an on-call group physician directly after hours; the standard length of a member visit; whether the member has a named physician with a capped panel; and whether virtual visits with the member's care team use credits instead of being charged.

## Standards by tier

| Tier | Same-day visit guaranteed | Same-day request cutoff (hour, 24-hour clock) | Portal message reply within (hours) | Direct after-hours physician access | Member visit length (minutes) | Named physician with a capped panel | Virtual visits use credits instead of being charged |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Linden Connect Virtual Membership | No | 0 (no guarantee) | 48 | No | 15 | No | Yes |
| Linden Essential Membership | No | 0 (no guarantee) | 24 | No | 30 | No | Yes |
| Linden Family Membership | Yes | 11 | 24 | No | 30 | No | Yes |
| Linden Plus Membership | Yes | 12 | 12 | Yes | 40 | No | Yes |
| Linden Premier Concierge Membership | Yes | 15 | 4 | Yes | 60 | Yes | Yes |
| Linden Executive Health Membership | Yes | 15 | 2 | Yes | 90 | Yes | Yes |

A cutoff hour of 0 means the tier gives no same-day guarantee.

## Reading the cutoff hour

The cutoff is an hour of the day on the 24-hour clock, and a same-day request is guaranteed when it is made before that hour.

| Tier | Hypothetical request time | Before the cutoff? |
|---|---|---|
| Linden Family Membership (cutoff 11) | 10:40 | Yes |
| Linden Family Membership (cutoff 11) | 11:20 | No |
| Linden Plus Membership (cutoff 12) | 11:55 | Yes |
| Linden Premier Concierge Membership (cutoff 15) | 14:30 | Yes |
| Linden Executive Health Membership (cutoff 15) | 15:10 | No |

On the Linden Connect Virtual Membership and the Linden Essential Membership no request time carries a same-day guarantee.
